datasets.name: readiness_headline
queryLines:
WITH chosen AS (
  SELECT measured_on, written_at
  FROM strata.ops.readiness_snapshot
  WHERE measured_on <= :measure_date
  ORDER BY measured_on DESC, written_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT s.measured_on, s.text AS headline
FROM strata.ops.readiness_snapshot AS s
JOIN chosen AS c ON c.measured_on = s.measured_on AND c.written_at = s.written_at
WHERE s.part = 'headline'

datasets.displayName: Contract-award rows per fiscal year, by dataset

)

datasets.name: readiness_sources

queryLines:

datasets.name: findings_governance
queryLines:

  CASE WHEN f.measured_on IS NULL THEN 'Not yet'

datasets.name: kpi_checks_failed
datasets.displayName: Quality checks failed in the latest nightly run
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id
  FROM strata.ops.quality_checks
  WHERE night BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  ORDER BY checked_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
last_tries AS (
  SELECT q.passed
  FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS q
  JOIN latest AS l ON q.run_id = l.run_id
  WHERE q.checked_at = (
    SELECT max(t.checked_at)
    FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS t
    WHERE t.run_id = q.run_id AND t.task_key = q.task_key
  )
),
counted AS (
  SELECT sum(CASE WHEN passed THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS failed, count(*) AS checks
  FROM last_tries
)
SELECT
  coalesce(failed, 0) AS numerator,
  checks AS denominator,
  coalesce(failed, 0) AS value,
  CASE
    WHEN checks = 0 THEN 'None yet'
    ELSE replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(coalesce(failed, 0), 0)), '{d}',
                 format_number(checks, 0))
  END AS display
FROM counted

datasets.name: kpi_azure_spend
queryLines:
WITH chosen AS (
  SELECT p.period_key, p.name, p.starts_on, p.ends_on, p.budget_usd
  FROM strata.ops.budget_periods AS p
  WHERE p.run_id = (SELECT max_by(b.run_id, b.written_at) FROM strata.ops.budget_periods AS b)
    AND (p.period_key = :budget_period OR (:budget_period = '' AND p.position = 1))
),
days AS (
  SELECT c.charged_on, c.cost_usd
  FROM strata.ops.azure_costs AS c
  WHERE c.pulled_at = (SELECT max(n.pulled_at) FROM strata.ops.azure_costs AS n WHERE n.charged_on = c.charged_on)
),
spent AS (
  SELECT count(d.charged_on) AS charges, max(d.charged_on) AS latest_day, round(sum(d.cost_usd), 2) AS spent
  FROM days AS d
  JOIN chosen AS p ON (p.starts_on IS NULL OR d.charged_on >= p.starts_on) AND d.charged_on <= p.ends_on
)
SELECT
  s.spent AS numerator,
  p.budget_usd AS denominator,
  s.spent AS value,
  CASE WHEN s.spent > p.budget_usd THEN round(s.spent - p.budget_usd, 2) ELSE 0 END AS over,
  s.latest_day,
  p.name AS period_name,
  CASE
    WHEN s.charges = 0 OR p.budget_usd IS NULL THEN 'No cost data yet'
    ELSE replace(replace('US${spent} of US${budget}', '{spent}', format_number(round(s.spent), 0)), '{budget}',
                 format_number(p.budget_usd, 0))
  END AS display
FROM spent AS s
LEFT JOIN chosen AS p ON TRUE

datasets.name: kpi_contacts_left
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id, checked_at
  FROM strata.ops.quality_checks
  WHERE check_kind = 'contacts_left' AND night BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  ORDER BY checked_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
found AS (
  SELECT sum(c.found) AS notices_left, sum(r.found) AS notices
  FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS c
  JOIN latest AS l ON c.run_id = l.run_id AND c.checked_at = l.checked_at
  LEFT JOIN strata.ops.quality_checks AS r
    ON r.run_id = c.run_id AND r.checked_at = c.checked_at AND r.table_name = c.table_name
   AND r.check_kind = 'row_count'
  WHERE c.check_kind = 'contacts_left'
)
SELECT
  notices_left AS numerator,
  notices AS denominator,
  notices_left AS value,
  CASE
    WHEN notices IS NULL OR notices = 0 THEN 'None yet'
    ELSE replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(notices_left, 0)), '{d}',
                 format_number(notices, 0))
  END AS display
FROM found

datasets.name: nightly_checks
queryLines:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT night, run_id, max(checked_at) AS last_checked
  FROM strata.ops.quality_checks
  WHERE night BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  GROUP BY night, run_id
),
last_runs AS (
  SELECT r.night, r.run_id
  FROM runs AS r
  WHERE r.last_checked = (SELECT max(o.last_checked) FROM runs AS o WHERE o.night = r.night)
),
last_tries AS (
  SELECT l.night, q.passed
  FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS q
  JOIN last_runs AS l ON q.run_id = l.run_id
  WHERE q.checked_at = (
    SELECT max(t.checked_at)
    FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS t
    WHERE t.run_id = q.run_id AND t.task_key = q.task_key
  )
)
SELECT
  night,
  CASE WHEN passed THEN 'Passed' ELSE 'Failed' END AS result,
  CASE WHEN passed THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS stack_order,
  count(*) AS checks
FROM last_tries
GROUP BY night, passed
ORDER BY night, stack_order

datasets.name: nightly_runs
queryLines:
WITH tries AS (
  SELECT
    p.run_id,
    p.task_key,
    p.status,
    p.rows_changed,
    p.started_at,
    p.finished_at,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY p.run_id, p.task_key) AS tries,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.run_id, p.task_key ORDER BY p.finished_at DESC) AS newest
  FROM strata.ops.pipeline_runs AS p
),
last_tries AS (
  SELECT run_id, task_key, status, rows_changed, tries, CASE task_key WHEN 'fetch_by_watermark' THEN 1 WHEN 'bronze_to_gold' THEN 2 WHEN 'parse_and_embed' THEN 3 WHEN 'sync_index' THEN 4 WHEN 'relink' THEN 5 WHEN 'propose_lessons' THEN 6 WHEN 'detect_disagreements' THEN 7 WHEN 'score' THEN 8 WHEN 'measure_data_readiness' THEN 9 WHEN 'refresh_drafts' THEN 10 END AS task_order
  FROM tries
  WHERE newest = 1
),
checks AS (
  SELECT
    q.run_id,
    max(q.night) AS night,
    sum(CASE WHEN q.passed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checks_passed,
    sum(CASE WHEN q.passed THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS checks_failed
  FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS q
  WHERE q.checked_at = (
    SELECT max(t.checked_at)
    FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS t
    WHERE t.run_id = q.run_id AND t.task_key = q.task_key
  )
  GROUP BY q.run_id
),
runs AS (
  SELECT t.run_id, min(t.started_at) AS started_at, max(t.finished_at) AS finished_at
  FROM tries AS t
  GROUP BY t.run_id
),
outcomes AS (
  SELECT
    l.run_id,
    sum(l.rows_changed) AS rows_changed,
    sum(CASE WHEN l.status = 'succeeded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS done,
    max(l.tries) AS most_tries,
    min(CASE WHEN l.status <> 'succeeded' THEN l.task_order END) AS stopped_order
  FROM last_tries AS l
  GROUP BY l.run_id
),
stopped AS (
  SELECT o.run_id, l.task_key AS stopped_task
  FROM outcomes AS o
  JOIN last_tries AS l ON l.run_id = o.run_id AND l.task_order = o.stopped_order
),
named AS (
  SELECT run_id, CASE stopped_task WHEN 'fetch_by_watermark' THEN 'Fetch what changed' WHEN 'bronze_to_gold' THEN 'Clean and model the records' WHEN 'parse_and_embed' THEN 'Read and index new documents' WHEN 'sync_index' THEN 'Update the search index' WHEN 'relink' THEN 'Link new contracts and passages' WHEN 'propose_lessons' THEN 'Propose lessons' WHEN 'detect_disagreements' THEN 'Find disagreements' WHEN 'score' THEN 'Score time estimates and signals' WHEN 'measure_data_readiness' THEN 'Measure data readiness' WHEN 'refresh_drafts' THEN 'Mark drafts that cite a changed lesson' ELSE stopped_task END AS stopped_label
  FROM stopped
)
SELECT
  coalesce(c.night, CAST(r.started_at AS DATE)) AS night,
  r.run_id,
  CASE
    WHEN n.stopped_label IS NOT NULL THEN replace('Stopped at {task}', '{task}', n.stopped_label)
    WHEN o.most_tries > 1 THEN 'Rerun, finished'
    ELSE 'Finished'
  END AS outcome,
  replace(replace('{done} of {tasks}', '{done}', CAST(o.done AS STRING)), '{tasks}',
          CAST(10 AS STRING)) AS tasks_finished,
  CAST(timestampdiff(MINUTE, r.started_at, r.finished_at) AS BIGINT) AS minutes,
  o.rows_changed,
  coalesce(c.checks_passed, 0) AS checks_passed,
  coalesce(c.checks_failed, 0) AS checks_failed,
  o.done AS tasks_done,
  n.stopped_label,
  o.most_tries
FROM runs AS r
JOIN outcomes AS o ON o.run_id = r.run_id
LEFT JOIN checks AS c ON c.run_id = r.run_id
LEFT JOIN named AS n ON n.run_id = r.run_id
WHERE coalesce(c.night, CAST(r.started_at AS DATE)) BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
ORDER BY r.started_at DESC

datasets.name: failed_checks
queryLines:
WITH failed AS (
  SELECT q.night, q.task_key, q.check_kind, q.table_name, q.key_name, q.found, q.expected_min, q.expected_max,
         q.checked_at
  FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS q
  WHERE NOT q.passed AND q.night BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
    AND q.checked_at = (
      SELECT max(t.checked_at)
      FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS t
      WHERE t.run_id = q.run_id AND t.task_key = q.task_key
    )
),
phrased AS (
  SELECT
    night,
    task_key,
    check_kind,
    table_name,
    checked_at,
    CASE check_kind
      WHEN 'row_count' THEN CASE WHEN found = 1 THEN '{found} row in {table}, outside the expected {min} to {max}'
                                 ELSE '{found} rows in {table}, outside the expected {min} to {max}' END
      WHEN 'missing_key' THEN CASE WHEN found = 1 THEN '{found} row in {table} with no {keyName}'
                                   ELSE '{found} rows in {table} with no {keyName}' END
      WHEN 'missing_public_from' THEN CASE WHEN found = 1 THEN '{found} row in {table} with no Disclosed date'
                                           ELSE '{found} rows in {table} with no Disclosed date' END
      WHEN 'duplicates' THEN CASE WHEN found = 1 THEN '{found} duplicate row in {table}'
                                  ELSE '{found} duplicate rows in {table}' END
      ELSE CASE WHEN found = 1 THEN 'contact details left in {found} notice'
                ELSE 'contact details left in {found} notices' END
    END AS template,
    found,
    expected_min,
    expected_max,
    key_name
  FROM failed
)
SELECT
  night,
  check_kind,
  found AS found_count,
  expected_min,
  expected_max,
  key_name,
  CASE task_key WHEN 'fetch_by_watermark' THEN 'Fetch what changed' WHEN 'bronze_to_gold' THEN 'Clean and model the records' WHEN 'parse_and_embed' THEN 'Read and index new documents' WHEN 'sync_index' THEN 'Update the search index' WHEN 'relink' THEN 'Link new contracts and passages' WHEN 'propose_lessons' THEN 'Propose lessons' WHEN 'detect_disagreements' THEN 'Find disagreements' WHEN 'score' THEN 'Score time estimates and signals' WHEN 'measure_data_readiness' THEN 'Measure data readiness' WHEN 'refresh_drafts' THEN 'Mark drafts that cite a changed lesson' ELSE task_key END AS task,
  CASE check_kind WHEN 'row_count' THEN 'Row count' WHEN 'missing_key' THEN 'Missing key' WHEN 'missing_public_from' THEN 'Missing Disclosed date' WHEN 'duplicates' THEN 'Duplicate rows' WHEN 'contacts_left' THEN 'Contact details left' ELSE check_kind END AS check_name,
  table_name,
  replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(template, '{found}', format_number(found, 0)), '{table}', table_name),
                          '{min}', coalesce(format_number(expected_min, 0), '')),
                  '{max}', coalesce(format_number(expected_max, 0), '')),
          '{keyName}', coalesce(key_name, '')) AS found
FROM phrased
ORDER BY checked_at DESC, task_key, check_kind, table_name

datasets.name: spend_by_day
datasets.displayName: Azure spend against the budget, by day
queryLines:
WITH chosen AS (
  SELECT p.starts_on, p.ends_on, p.budget_usd
  FROM strata.ops.budget_periods AS p
  WHERE p.run_id = (SELECT max_by(b.run_id, b.written_at) FROM strata.ops.budget_periods AS b)
    AND (p.period_key = :budget_period OR (:budget_period = '' AND p.position = 1))
),
days AS (
  SELECT c.charged_on, sum(c.cost_usd) AS spent
  FROM strata.ops.azure_costs AS c
  JOIN chosen AS p ON (p.starts_on IS NULL OR c.charged_on >= p.starts_on) AND c.charged_on <= p.ends_on
  WHERE c.pulled_at = (SELECT max(n.pulled_at) FROM strata.ops.azure_costs AS n WHERE n.charged_on = c.charged_on)
  GROUP BY c.charged_on
)
SELECT
  d.charged_on,
  round(d.spent, 2) AS spent_that_day,
  round(sum(d.spent) OVER (ORDER BY d.charged_on ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS spent_so_far,
  p.budget_usd
FROM days AS d
CROSS JOIN chosen AS p
ORDER BY d.charged_on

datasets.name: spend_by_service
queryLines:
WITH chosen AS (
  SELECT p.starts_on, p.ends_on
  FROM strata.ops.budget_periods AS p
  WHERE p.run_id = (SELECT max_by(b.run_id, b.written_at) FROM strata.ops.budget_periods AS b)

)

datasets.name: spend_by_resource
datasets.displayName: Azure spend by service and resource
queryLines:
WITH chosen AS (

  FROM strata.ops.budget_periods AS p

datasets.name: contact_removals
queryLines:
SELECT
  CASE kind WHEN 'names' THEN 1 WHEN 'emails' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS position,
  CASE kind WHEN 'names' THEN 'Contact names' WHEN 'emails' THEN 'Email addresses' WHEN 'phones' THEN 'Phone numbers' ELSE kind END AS kind,
  sum(removed) AS removed,
  sum(records) AS notices,
  CAST(max(fetched_at) AS DATE) AS last_removed
FROM strata.ops.contact_removals
WHERE kind IN ('names', 'emails', 'phones') AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
GROUP BY kind
ORDER BY position

datasets.name: queries
queryLines:
WITH reads AS (
  SELECT
    l.event_date,
    l.created_by,
    CASE
      WHEN l.entity_type IS NULL THEN 'app'
      WHEN l.entity_type LIKE '%GENIE%' THEN 'genie'
      WHEN l.entity_type LIKE '%DASHBOARD%' THEN 'dashboard'
      WHEN l.entity_type LIKE '%QUERY%' THEN 'sql_editor'
      WHEN l.entity_type = 'NOTEBOOK' THEN 'notebook'
      WHEN l.entity_type IN ('JOB', 'PIPELINE') THEN 'job'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS through_key,
    l.source_table_full_name,
    l.statement_id
  FROM system.access.table_lineage AS l
  WHERE l.source_table_catalog = 'strata' AND l.event_date BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
)
SELECT
  event_date AS day,
  created_by AS person,
  CASE through_key WHEN 'app' THEN 'Strata app' WHEN 'genie' THEN 'Genie' WHEN 'dashboard' THEN 'Dashboard' WHEN 'sql_editor' THEN 'SQL editor' WHEN 'notebook' THEN 'Notebook' WHEN 'job' THEN 'Job' WHEN 'other' THEN 'Another way' ELSE through_key END AS through,
  source_table_full_name AS table_read,
  count(DISTINCT statement_id) AS queries
FROM reads
GROUP BY event_date, created_by, through_key, source_table_full_name
ORDER BY day DESC, person, through, table_read

datasets.name: lineage_run
queryLines:
WITH chosen AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.finished_at, r.view AS view_key, r.question, r.sentences_kept, r.sentences_removed
  FROM strata.ops.agent_runs AS r
  WHERE r.run_id = CASE WHEN :run_id = '' THEN (
      SELECT max_by(n.run_id, n.finished_at) FROM strata.ops.agent_runs AS n
    ) ELSE :run_id END
),
counted AS (
  SELECT
    c.run_id,
    c.finished_at,
    c.view_key,
    c.question,
    c.sentences_kept,
    c.sentences_removed,
    count(t.call_order) AS tool_calls,
    coalesce(max(CASE WHEN t.private_upload THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS private_upload
  FROM chosen AS c
  LEFT JOIN strata.ops.tool_calls AS t ON t.run_id = c.run_id
  GROUP BY c.run_id, c.finished_at, c.view_key, c.question, c.sentences_kept, c.sentences_removed
)
SELECT
  run_id,
  finished_at AS asked,
  CASE view_key WHEN 'staff' THEN 'World Bank staff' WHEN 'piu' THEN 'Implementing agency' WHEN 'public' THEN 'Public' ELSE view_key END AS view,
  CASE WHEN private_upload = 1 THEN 'Not shown, because this run read a private upload.' ELSE question END AS question,
  tool_calls,
  sentences_kept,
  sentences_removed
FROM counted

datasets.name: lineage_calls
queryLines:
SELECT t.call_order, t.tool, t.inputs, t.rows_returned, t.took_ms, t.evidence_ids
FROM strata.ops.tool_calls AS t
WHERE t.run_id = CASE WHEN :run_id = '' THEN (
    SELECT max_by(n.run_id, n.finished_at) FROM strata.ops.agent_runs AS n
  ) ELSE :run_id END
ORDER BY t.call_order

datasets.name: lineage_reads
queryLines:
WITH chosen AS (
  SELECT r.run_id, r.call_order, r.tool, r.table_name, r.version_read, r.sources, r.read_at
  FROM strata.ops.tool_call_reads AS r
  WHERE r.run_id = CASE WHEN :run_id = '' THEN (
      SELECT max_by(n.run_id, n.finished_at) FROM strata.ops.agent_runs AS n
    ) ELSE :run_id END
)
SELECT
  c.call_order,
  replace(replace('{order}. {tool}', '{order}', CAST(c.call_order AS STRING)), '{tool}', c.tool) AS call,
  c.table_name,
  c.version_read,
  coalesce(
    (SELECT max(q.night) FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS q
     WHERE q.table_name = c.table_name AND q.checked_at <= c.read_at),
    (SELECT max(q.night) FROM strata.ops.quality_checks AS q WHERE q.checked_at <= c.read_at)
  ) AS written_by,
  c.sources
FROM chosen AS c
ORDER BY c.call_order, c.table_name

datasets.name: recent_runs
queryLines:
WITH counted AS (
  SELECT r.finished_at, r.run_id, r.view AS view_key, r.sentences_removed, count(t.call_order) AS tool_calls
  FROM strata.ops.agent_runs AS r
  LEFT JOIN strata.ops.tool_calls AS t ON t.run_id = r.run_id
  WHERE r.public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  GROUP BY r.finished_at, r.run_id, r.view, r.sentences_removed
)
SELECT finished_at AS asked, run_id, CASE view_key WHEN 'staff' THEN 'World Bank staff' WHEN 'piu' THEN 'Implementing agency' WHEN 'public' THEN 'Public' ELSE view_key END AS view, tool_calls, sentences_removed
FROM counted
ORDER BY finished_at DESC

datasets.name: findings_ai
queryLines:
SELECT
  f.position,
  f.about,
  f.finding,
  CASE WHEN f.measured_on IS NULL THEN 'Not yet'
       ELSE date_format(f.measured_on, 'MMM d, yyyy') END AS measured

datasets.name: kpi_benchmark_passed
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id
  FROM strata.ops.evaluation_result
  WHERE scorer = 'benchmark' AND segment_kind = 'kind' AND segment = 'all'
    AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  ORDER BY ran_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
counted AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN e.measure = 'passed' THEN e.value END) AS BIGINT) AS passed,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN e.measure = 'questions' THEN e.value END) AS BIGINT) AS questions
  FROM strata.ops.evaluation_result AS e
  JOIN latest AS l ON e.run_id = l.run_id
  WHERE e.scorer = 'benchmark' AND e.segment_kind = 'kind' AND e.segment = 'all'
)
SELECT
  passed AS numerator,
  questions AS denominator,
  passed AS value,
  CASE
    WHEN questions IS NULL OR questions = 0 THEN 'None yet'
    ELSE replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(passed, 0)), '{d}',
                 format_number(questions, 0))
  END AS display
FROM counted

datasets.name: kpi_sentences_removed
queryLines:
WITH counted AS (
  SELECT sum(sentences_removed) AS removed, sum(sentences_written) AS written
  FROM strata.ops.agent_runs
  WHERE status = 'answered' AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
)
SELECT
  coalesce(removed, 0) AS numerator,
  coalesce(written, 0) AS denominator,
  coalesce(removed, 0) AS value,
  CASE
    WHEN coalesce(written, 0) = 0 THEN 'None yet'
    ELSE replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(coalesce(removed, 0), 0)), '{d}',
                 format_number(written, 0))
  END AS display
FROM counted

datasets.name: kpi_answers_held_back
queryLines:
WITH answers AS (
  SELECT run_id
  FROM strata.ops.agent_runs
  WHERE status = 'answered' AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
),
held AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.run_id
  FROM strata.ops.tool_calls AS c
  JOIN answers AS a ON c.run_id = a.run_id
  WHERE c.abstention IN ('too_few_comparables', 'outside_training', 'asof_before_training', 'no_public_notice',
                         'none_measurable')
),
counted AS (
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM held) AS held, (SELECT count(*) FROM answers) AS answers
)
SELECT
  held AS numerator,
  answers AS denominator,
  held AS value,
  CASE
    WHEN answers = 0 THEN 'None yet'
    ELSE replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(held, 0)), '{d}', format_number(answers, 0))
  END AS display
FROM counted

datasets.name: kpi_weekly_users
queryLines:
WITH week AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('WEEK', date_add(:dates.max, 1)) AS DATE) AS week_after
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_add(week_after, -7) AS DATE) AS week_start, week_after
  FROM week
),
people AS (
  SELECT count(DISTINCT u.viewer_id) AS people, min(b.week_start) AS week_start
  FROM bounds AS b
  LEFT JOIN strata.ops.usage_events AS u
    ON u.public_from >= b.week_start AND u.public_from < b.week_after AND u.public_from >= :dates.min
   AND u.route NOT LIKE '/api/%' AND u.viewer_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  people AS numerator,
  CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS denominator,
  people AS value,
  week_start,
  format_number(people, 0) AS display
FROM people

datasets.name: kpi_drafts_exported
queryLines:
WITH started AS (
  SELECT draft_id
  FROM strata.ops.drafts
  WHERE public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
),
exported AS (

  FROM started AS s

),
counted AS (

)
SELECT
  exported AS numerator,
  started AS denominator,
  exported AS value,
  CASE
    WHEN started = 0 THEN 'None yet'
    ELSE replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(exported, 0)), '{d}',

FROM counted

datasets.name: kpi_plan_rows_offered

queryLines:
WITH latest AS (

counted AS (

SELECT

  END AS display
FROM counted

datasets.name: benchmark_shares
datasets.displayName: Share of benchmark questions passed, per full gate run
queryLines:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    max(ran_at) AS ran_at,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN measure = 'passed' THEN value END) AS BIGINT) AS passed,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN measure = 'questions' THEN value END) AS BIGINT) AS questions,
    max(CASE WHEN measure = 'share' THEN value END) AS share
  FROM strata.ops.evaluation_result
  WHERE scorer = 'benchmark' AND segment_kind = 'kind' AND segment = 'all'
    AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  GROUP BY run_id
)
SELECT
  CAST(ran_at AS DATE) AS run_on,
  passed,
  questions,
  CASE WHEN questions >= 50
       THEN CAST(round(100 * share) AS BIGINT) END AS share_percent
FROM runs
ORDER BY ran_at

datasets.name: foundry_latest
datasets.displayName: Answers that met Microsoft Foundry's threshold, by evaluator
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id
  FROM strata.ops.evaluation_result
  WHERE scorer = 'foundry_evaluation' AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  ORDER BY ran_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
evaluators AS (
  SELECT
    e.segment AS evaluator_key,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN e.measure = 'scored' THEN e.value END) AS BIGINT) AS scored,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN e.measure = 'met' THEN e.value END) AS BIGINT) AS met,
    max(CASE WHEN e.measure = 'share' THEN e.value END) AS share
  FROM strata.ops.evaluation_result AS e
  JOIN latest AS l ON e.run_id = l.run_id
  WHERE e.scorer = 'foundry_evaluation' AND e.segment_kind = 'evaluator'
  GROUP BY e.segment
)
SELECT
  CASE evaluator_key WHEN 'groundedness' THEN 1 WHEN 'relevance' THEN 2 WHEN 'task_adherence' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
    AS position,
  CASE evaluator_key WHEN 'groundedness' THEN 'Groundedness' WHEN 'relevance' THEN 'Relevance' WHEN 'task_adherence' THEN 'Task adherence' WHEN 'tool_use' THEN 'Tool use' ELSE evaluator_key END AS evaluator,
  met,
  scored,
  CASE WHEN scored >= 50
       THEN CAST(round(100 * share) AS BIGINT) END AS share_percent
FROM evaluators
ORDER BY position

datasets.name: benchmark_results
queryLines:
WITH kinds AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    segment AS kind_key,
    max(ran_at) AS ran_at,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN measure = 'passed' THEN value END) AS BIGINT) AS passed,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN measure = 'questions' THEN value END) AS BIGINT) AS questions,
    max(CASE WHEN measure = 'share' THEN value END) AS share,
    max(CASE WHEN measure = 'target' THEN value END) AS target,
    max(CASE WHEN measure = 'gap' THEN value END) AS gap,
    max(CASE WHEN measure = 'met' THEN value END) AS met
  FROM strata.ops.evaluation_result
  WHERE scorer = 'benchmark' AND segment_kind = 'kind' AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  GROUP BY run_id, segment
)
SELECT
  run_id,
  CAST(ran_at AS DATE) AS run_on,
  kind_key,
  share,
  target AS target_share,
  met,
  CASE kind_key WHEN 'sql' THEN 1 WHEN 'documents' THEN 2 WHEN 'estimates' THEN 3 WHEN 'must_refuse' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END
    AS position,
  CASE kind_key WHEN 'sql' THEN 'SQL' WHEN 'documents' THEN 'Documents' WHEN 'estimates' THEN 'Estimates' WHEN 'must_refuse' THEN 'Must refuse' WHEN 'all' THEN 'All' ELSE kind_key END AS kind,
  passed,
  questions,
  concat(CAST(CAST(round(100 * target) AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '%') AS target,
  CASE WHEN met = 1 THEN 'Met'
       ELSE replace('Missed by {gap} points', '{gap}', CAST(CAST(round(100 * gap) AS BIGINT) AS STRING))
  END AS against
FROM kinds
ORDER BY ran_at DESC, position

datasets.name: foundry_results
queryLines:
WITH evaluators AS (

    run_id,
    segment AS evaluator_key,

SELECT

    AS position,

  scored,

FROM evaluators
ORDER BY ran_at DESC, position

datasets.name: removed_reasons
queryLines:
WITH removed AS (
  SELECT a.reason
  FROM strata.ops.answer_removals AS a
  JOIN strata.ops.agent_runs AS r ON r.run_id = a.run_id
  WHERE r.status = 'answered' AND r.public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
),
labelled AS (
  SELECT CASE reason WHEN 'number_not_in_records' THEN 'No record supports a number or date' WHEN 'date_not_in_records' THEN 'No record supports a number or date' WHEN 'number_only_in_table_summary' THEN 'No record supports a number or date' WHEN 'id_not_returned' THEN "Cited a source I didn't retrieve" WHEN 'no_source' THEN "Its sources don't say this" WHEN 'quote_not_on_page' THEN 'Quote not on the page it cites' WHEN 'quote_not_in_sentence' THEN 'Quote not on the page it cites' WHEN 'not_supported' THEN "Its sources don't say this" WHEN 'judge_unavailable' THEN "The judging model didn't respond" WHEN 'advice_without_lesson_or_comparable' THEN 'Advice without a lesson or comparable package' WHEN 'disagreements_unavailable' THEN 'Rests on a disputed report' ELSE reason END AS reason_label
  FROM removed
)
SELECT
  reason_label AS reason,
  count(*) AS sentences,
  count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY count(*)) AS reasons_at_this_count
FROM labelled
GROUP BY reason_label
ORDER BY sentences DESC, reason

datasets.name: held_reasons
datasets.displayName: Answers where I held back, by reason
queryLines:
WITH held AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.run_id, c.abstention
  FROM strata.ops.tool_calls AS c
  JOIN strata.ops.agent_runs AS r ON r.run_id = c.run_id
  WHERE r.status = 'answered' AND r.public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
    AND c.abstention IN ('too_few_comparables', 'outside_training', 'asof_before_training', 'no_public_notice',
                         'none_measurable')
),
labelled AS (
  SELECT run_id, CASE abstention WHEN 'too_few_comparables' THEN 'Too few comparable packages for a range' WHEN 'outside_training' THEN 'Outside what my model learned from' WHEN 'asof_before_training' THEN 'Asked as of a date before my first model' WHEN 'no_public_notice' THEN 'No public notice to measure from' WHEN 'none_measurable' THEN 'No comparable package to measure from' ELSE abstention END AS reason_label
  FROM held
)
SELECT
  reason_label AS reason,
  count(DISTINCT run_id) AS answers,
  count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY count(DISTINCT run_id)) AS reasons_at_this_count
FROM labelled
GROUP BY reason_label
ORDER BY answers DESC, reason

datasets.name: reasons
datasets.displayName: Removed sentences and held-back answers, by reason
queryLines:
WITH answers AS (
  SELECT run_id, sentences_written
  FROM strata.ops.agent_runs
  WHERE status = 'answered' AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
),
totals AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(sentences_written), 0) AS written, count(*) AS answered
  FROM answers
),
removed AS (
  SELECT r.reason
  FROM strata.ops.answer_removals AS r
  JOIN answers AS a ON a.run_id = r.run_id
),
removed_labels AS (
  SELECT CASE reason WHEN 'number_not_in_records' THEN 'No record supports a number or date' WHEN 'date_not_in_records' THEN 'No record supports a number or date' WHEN 'number_only_in_table_summary' THEN 'No record supports a number or date' WHEN 'id_not_returned' THEN "Cited a source I didn't retrieve" WHEN 'no_source' THEN "Its sources don't say this" WHEN 'quote_not_on_page' THEN 'Quote not on the page it cites' WHEN 'quote_not_in_sentence' THEN 'Quote not on the page it cites' WHEN 'not_supported' THEN "Its sources don't say this" WHEN 'judge_unavailable' THEN "The judging model didn't respond" WHEN 'advice_without_lesson_or_comparable' THEN 'Advice without a lesson or comparable package' WHEN 'disagreements_unavailable' THEN 'Rests on a disputed report' ELSE reason END AS reason_label
  FROM removed
),
held AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.run_id, c.abstention
  FROM strata.ops.tool_calls AS c
  JOIN answers AS a ON a.run_id = c.run_id
  WHERE c.abstention IN ('too_few_comparables', 'outside_training', 'asof_before_training', 'no_public_notice',
                         'none_measurable')
),
held_labels AS (
  SELECT run_id, CASE abstention WHEN 'too_few_comparables' THEN 'Too few comparable packages for a range' WHEN 'outside_training' THEN 'Outside what my model learned from' WHEN 'asof_before_training' THEN 'Asked as of a date before my first model' WHEN 'no_public_notice' THEN 'No public notice to measure from' WHEN 'none_measurable' THEN 'No comparable package to measure from' ELSE abstention END AS reason_label
  FROM held
),
counted AS (
  SELECT 1 AS position, reason_label, count(*) AS reason_count FROM removed_labels GROUP BY reason_label
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 2 AS position, reason_label, count(DISTINCT run_id) AS reason_count FROM held_labels GROUP BY reason_label
)
SELECT
  c.position,
  CASE WHEN c.position = 1 THEN 'Removed sentence' ELSE 'Held-back answer' END AS what,
  c.reason_label AS reason,
  c.reason_count AS count,
  CASE WHEN c.position = 1 THEN replace('{written} sentences written', '{written}', format_number(t.written, 0))
       ELSE replace('{answers} answers', '{answers}', format_number(t.answered, 0)) END AS out_of
FROM counted AS c
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
ORDER BY c.position, c.reason_count DESC, c.reason_label

datasets.name: loop_indicators
queryLines:
SELECT
  i.position,
  i.loop,
  i.indicator,
  i.kind,
  i.latest,
  i.target,

datasets.name: kpi_days_to_decision
queryLines:
SELECT
  v.decided_on,
  v.published_on,
  v.days_from_publication,
  v.project_id,
  CASE WHEN d.document_type IS NULL THEN v.project_id ELSE concat(d.document_type, ', ', v.project_id) END AS report
FROM strata.ops.lesson_versions AS v
LEFT JOIN strata.ops.lesson_review_items AS i ON i.item_id = v.item_id
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT document_id, document_type
  FROM strata.gold.passage
) AS d ON i.proposal_id LIKE concat(d.document_id, '/%')
WHERE v.version = 1
  AND v.days_from_publication IS NOT NULL
  AND v.decided_on BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max

datasets.name: kpi_wrong_passage_rate
queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT f.week_start, f.kind, f.reports, f.opened, f.per_100
  FROM strata.ops.retrieval_feedback_weekly AS f
  WHERE f.week_start BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
    AND f.computed_at = (
      SELECT max(n.computed_at)
      FROM strata.ops.retrieval_feedback_weekly AS n
      WHERE n.week_start = f.week_start AND n.kind = f.kind
    )
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT
    week_start,
    max(opened) AS opened,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN kind = 'wrong_passage' THEN reports END) AS BIGINT) AS wrong_passage,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN kind = 'not_useful' THEN reports END) AS BIGINT) AS not_useful,
    max(CASE WHEN kind = 'wrong_passage' THEN per_100 END) AS wrong_per_100,
    max(CASE WHEN kind = 'not_useful' THEN per_100 END) AS not_useful_per_100
  FROM latest
  GROUP BY week_start
)
SELECT
  week_start,
  opened,
  coalesce(wrong_passage, 0) AS wrong_passage,
  coalesce(not_useful, 0) AS not_useful,
  wrong_per_100,
  not_useful_per_100,
  CASE
    WHEN wrong_per_100 IS NOT NULL THEN format_number(round(wrong_per_100, 1), 1)
    ELSE replace(replace('{reports} in {opened}', '{reports}', format_number(coalesce(wrong_passage, 0), 0)),
                 '{opened}', format_number(opened, 0))
  END AS wrong_per_100_cell
FROM weeks
ORDER BY week_start DESC

datasets.name: kpi_rolling_coverage
datasets.displayName: Coverage of my 8-in-10 range, rolling 12 months
queryLines:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT w.month, w.count AS inside, w.denominator AS finished
  FROM strata.ops.estimates_watch AS w
  WHERE w.measure = 'coverage' AND w.segment = 'all' AND w.month BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
    AND w.measured_at = (
      SELECT max(n.measured_at)
      FROM strata.ops.estimates_watch AS n
      WHERE n.measure = 'coverage' AND n.segment = 'all' AND n.month = w.month
    )
)
SELECT
  month,
  finished,
  inside,
  inside AS numerator,
  finished AS denominator,
  CASE WHEN finished >= 50 THEN CAST(round(100.0 * inside / finished) AS BIGINT) END AS coverage_percent,
  CASE WHEN finished >= 50 THEN CASE WHEN inside > 0 AND inside < finished AND round((100.0 * inside / finished)) = 0 THEN replace('{count}, <1%', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(inside, 0)), '{d}', format_number(finished, 0))) WHEN inside > 0 AND inside < finished AND round((100.0 * inside / finished)) = 100 THEN replace('{count}, >99%', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(inside, 0)), '{d}', format_number(finished, 0))) ELSE replace(replace('{count}, {pct}%', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(inside, 0)), '{d}', format_number(finished, 0))), '{pct}', CAST(CAST(round((100.0 * inside / finished)) AS BIGINT) AS STRING)) END WHEN finished >= 20 AND inside > 0 AND inside < finished THEN CASE WHEN round((10.0 * inside / finished)) = 0 THEN replace('{count}, fewer than 1 in 10', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(inside, 0)), '{d}', format_number(finished, 0))) WHEN round((10.0 * inside / finished)) = 10 THEN replace('{count}, more than 9 in 10', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(inside, 0)), '{d}', format_number(finished, 0))) WHEN (10 * inside) % finished = 0 THEN replace(replace('{count}, {in10} in 10', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(inside, 0)), '{d}', format_number(finished, 0))), '{in10}', CAST(CAST(round((10.0 * inside / finished)) AS BIGINT) AS STRING)) ELSE replace(replace('{count}, about {in10} in 10', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(inside, 0)), '{d}', format_number(finished, 0))), '{in10}', CAST(CAST(round((10.0 * inside / finished)) AS BIGINT) AS STRING)) END ELSE replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(inside, 0)), '{d}', format_number(finished, 0)) END AS coverage_cell,
  CAST(round(100 * 0.75) AS BIGINT) AS target_low,
  CAST(round(100 * 0.85) AS BIGINT) AS target_high
FROM months
ORDER BY month DESC

datasets.name: kpi_blamed_covered
queryLines:
WITH releases AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    segment AS release_name,
    max(ran_at) AS ran_at,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN measure = 'projects' THEN value END) AS BIGINT) AS projects,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN measure = 'blamed' THEN value END) AS BIGINT) AS blamed,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN measure = 'covered' THEN value END) AS BIGINT) AS covered,
    max(CASE WHEN measure = 'shown_when_covered' THEN value_text END) AS shown_when_covered,
    max(CASE WHEN measure = 'hindsight_recall' THEN value_text END) AS recall_counts,
    max(CASE WHEN measure = 'hindsight_recall' THEN value END) AS recall,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN measure = 'checklist_caught' THEN value END) AS BIGINT) AS checklist_caught
  FROM strata.ops.evaluation_result
  WHERE scorer = 'hindsight_test' AND segment_kind = 'release' AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  GROUP BY run_id, segment
)
SELECT
  release_name,
  CAST(ran_at AS DATE) AS ran_on,
  projects,
  blamed,
  covered,
  covered AS numerator,
  blamed AS denominator,
  shown_when_covered,
  recall,
  CASE
    WHEN blamed >= 50 AND recall IS NOT NULL
      THEN replace(replace('{count}, {pct}%', '{count}', recall_counts), '{pct}',
                   CAST(CAST(round(100 * recall) AS BIGINT) AS STRING))
    WHEN blamed >= 20 AND recall > 0 AND recall < 1
      THEN replace(replace('{count}, about {in10} in 10', '{count}', recall_counts), '{in10}',
                   CAST(CAST(round(10 * recall) AS BIGINT) AS STRING))
    ELSE recall_counts
  END AS hindsight_recall,
  checklist_caught
FROM releases
ORDER BY ran_at DESC

datasets.name: kpi_precision_recall
datasets.displayName: Precision at 10 and recall at 20, held-out set
queryLines:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT
    run_id,
    segment_kind,
    segment AS query_set_key,
    max(ran_at) AS ran_at,
    CAST(max(CASE WHEN measure = 'queries' THEN value END) AS BIGINT) AS queries,
    max(CASE WHEN measure LIKE 'precision_at_%' THEN value END) AS precision_at_10,
    max(CASE WHEN measure LIKE 'recall_at_%' THEN value END) AS recall_at_20,
    max(CASE WHEN measure LIKE 'ndcg_at_%' THEN value END) AS ndcg_at_10
  FROM strata.ops.evaluation_result
  WHERE scorer = 'retrieval_evaluation' AND segment_kind IN ('query_set', 'held_out')
    AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  GROUP BY run_id, segment_kind, segment
)
SELECT
  run_id,
  CAST(ran_at AS DATE) AS run_on,
  segment_kind,
  query_set_key,
  CASE query_set_key WHEN 'icr_review_citations' THEN "ICR Reviews' citations" WHEN 'pad_lessons' THEN "PADs' lessons sections" WHEN 'notice_queries' THEN 'Questions written from award notices' WHEN 'bilingual_en_fr' THEN 'English questions, French passages' WHEN 'bilingual_fr_en' THEN 'French questions, English passages' ELSE query_set_key END AS query_set,
  queries,
  precision_at_10,
  recall_at_20,
  ndcg_at_10,
  CASE WHEN segment_kind = 'held_out' AND queries >= 20 THEN precision_at_10 END
    AS held_out_precision,
  CASE WHEN segment_kind = 'held_out' AND queries >= 20 THEN recall_at_20 END
    AS held_out_recall
FROM runs
ORDER BY ran_at DESC, segment_kind, query_set_key

queryLines:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT run_id, month
  FROM strata.ops.estimates_watch
  WHERE measure = 'plan_accuracy' AND month BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  ORDER BY measured_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
groups AS (
  SELECT
    w.segment,
    max(CASE WHEN w.measure = 'plan_accuracy' THEN w.count END) AS with_actual,
    max(CASE WHEN w.measure = 'plan_accuracy' THEN w.value END) AS median_days,
    max(CASE WHEN w.measure = 'plan_duration' THEN w.count END) AS with_cycle,
    max(CASE WHEN w.measure = 'plan_duration' THEN w.value END) AS median_months
  FROM strata.ops.estimates_watch AS w
  JOIN latest AS l ON w.run_id = l.run_id AND w.month = l.month
  WHERE w.measure IN ('plan_accuracy', 'plan_duration')
  GROUP BY w.segment
)
SELECT
  CASE segment WHEN 'anchored/using_strata' THEN 1 WHEN 'anchored/not_yet' THEN 2 WHEN 'other/using_strata' THEN 3
               ELSE 4 END AS position,
  segment,
  CASE WHEN segment LIKE 'anchored/%' THEN 'Dated within 14 days of a date I offered'
       ELSE 'Other plan rows' END AS plan_rows,
  CASE WHEN segment LIKE '%/using_strata' THEN 'Using Strata'
       ELSE 'Not yet using Strata' END AS countries,
  with_actual,
  median_days,
  CASE
    WHEN median_days IS NOT NULL THEN format_number(round(median_days), 0)
    WHEN with_actual = 1 THEN replace('{n} row, too few for a median', '{n}', format_number(with_actual, 0))
    ELSE replace('{n} rows, too few for a median', '{n}', format_number(coalesce(with_actual, 0), 0))
  END AS median_days_cell,
  CASE
    WHEN median_months IS NOT NULL THEN format_number(round(median_months, 1), 1)
    WHEN with_cycle = 1 THEN replace('{n} row, too few for a median', '{n}', format_number(with_cycle, 0))
    ELSE replace('{n} rows, too few for a median', '{n}', format_number(coalesce(with_cycle, 0), 0))
  END AS median_months_cell
FROM groups
ORDER BY position

datasets.name: use_by_week
datasets.displayName: People who used Strata, by week
queryLines:
WITH people AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('WEEK', public_from) AS DATE) AS week_start, count(DISTINCT viewer_id) AS people
  FROM strata.ops.usage_events
  WHERE public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max AND route NOT LIKE '/api/%' AND viewer_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('WEEK', public_from) AS DATE)
),
answers AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('WEEK', public_from) AS DATE) AS week_start, count(*) AS answers
  FROM strata.ops.agent_runs
  WHERE status = 'answered' AND public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('WEEK', public_from) AS DATE)
),
started AS (
  SELECT CAST(date_trunc('WEEK', public_from) AS DATE) AS week_start, count(*) AS started
  FROM strata.ops.drafts
  WHERE public_from BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('WEEK', public_from) AS DATE)
),
reached AS (
  SELECT draft_id, state, min(public_from) AS reached_on
  FROM strata.ops.draft_states
  WHERE state IN ('checked', 'exported')
  GROUP BY draft_id, state
),
states AS (
  SELECT
    CAST(date_trunc('WEEK', reached_on) AS DATE) AS week_start,
    sum(CASE WHEN state = 'checked' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS checked,
    sum(CASE WHEN state = 'exported' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS exported
  FROM reached
  WHERE reached_on BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
  GROUP BY CAST(date_trunc('WEEK', reached_on) AS DATE)
),
weeks AS (
  SELECT week_start FROM people
  UNION SELECT week_start FROM answers
  UNION SELECT week_start FROM started
  UNION SELECT week_start FROM states
)
SELECT
  w.week_start,
  coalesce(p.people, 0) AS people,
  coalesce(a.answers, 0) AS answers,
  coalesce(s.started, 0) AS started,
  coalesce(st.checked, 0) AS checked,
  coalesce(st.exported, 0) AS exported
FROM weeks AS w
LEFT JOIN people AS p ON p.week_start = w.week_start
LEFT JOIN answers AS a ON a.week_start = w.week_start
LEFT JOIN started AS s ON s.week_start = w.week_start
LEFT JOIN states AS st ON st.week_start = w.week_start
ORDER BY w.week_start DESC

datasets.name: plan_rows_by_month
datasets.displayName: Plan rows after I showed a range, by month
queryLines:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT w.month, w.count AS anchored, w.denominator AS plan_rows
  FROM strata.ops.estimates_watch AS w
  WHERE w.measure = 'anchored_rows' AND w.segment = 'published_in_month' AND w.month BETWEEN :dates.min AND :dates.max
    AND w.measured_at = (
      SELECT max(n.measured_at)
      FROM strata.ops.estimates_watch AS n
      WHERE n.measure = 'anchored_rows' AND n.segment = 'published_in_month' AND n.month = w.month
    )
)
SELECT month, plan_rows, anchored, CASE WHEN plan_rows >= 50 THEN CASE WHEN anchored > 0 AND anchored < plan_rows AND round((100.0 * anchored / plan_rows)) = 0 THEN replace('{count}, <1%', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(anchored, 0)), '{d}', format_number(plan_rows, 0))) WHEN anchored > 0 AND anchored < plan_rows AND round((100.0 * anchored / plan_rows)) = 100 THEN replace('{count}, >99%', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(anchored, 0)), '{d}', format_number(plan_rows, 0))) ELSE replace(replace('{count}, {pct}%', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(anchored, 0)), '{d}', format_number(plan_rows, 0))), '{pct}', CAST(CAST(round((100.0 * anchored / plan_rows)) AS BIGINT) AS STRING)) END WHEN plan_rows >= 20 AND anchored > 0 AND anchored < plan_rows THEN CASE WHEN round((10.0 * anchored / plan_rows)) = 0 THEN replace('{count}, fewer than 1 in 10', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(anchored, 0)), '{d}', format_number(plan_rows, 0))) WHEN round((10.0 * anchored / plan_rows)) = 10 THEN replace('{count}, more than 9 in 10', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(anchored, 0)), '{d}', format_number(plan_rows, 0))) WHEN (10 * anchored) % plan_rows = 0 THEN replace(replace('{count}, {in10} in 10', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(anchored, 0)), '{d}', format_number(plan_rows, 0))), '{in10}', CAST(CAST(round((10.0 * anchored / plan_rows)) AS BIGINT) AS STRING)) ELSE replace(replace('{count}, about {in10} in 10', '{count}', replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(anchored, 0)), '{d}', format_number(plan_rows, 0))), '{in10}', CAST(CAST(round((10.0 * anchored / plan_rows)) AS BIGINT) AS STRING)) END ELSE replace(replace('{n} of {d}', '{n}', format_number(anchored, 0)), '{d}', format_number(plan_rows, 0)) END AS share
FROM months
ORDER BY month DESC

Implementation Completion and Results Report (ICR), Project Performance Assessment Report (PPAR), normalized discounted cumulative gain at 10 (nDCG at 10). ICR Review is the World Bank's own name.
- **Days from publication to decision.** Calendar days from the day an Implementation Completion and Results Report (ICR), ICR Review or Project Performance Assessment Report (PPAR) was published to the day a lead procurement specialist decided on a lesson proposed from it. The target is a decision within 10 business days.
- **Blamed risks a lesson covered at approval.** In the hindsight test, the risks that completion reports later blamed, and how many of them a lesson in my library already covered on the project's approval date.
- **Wrong-passage reports per 100 sources opened.** How many passages people marked as wrong for every 100 sources they opened from an answer. Reports sent in a preview, and reports that were withdrawn, don't count.
- **Precision at 10 and recall at 20.** On the held-out set of labeled queries, precision at 10 is the share of my top 10 passages that a person labeled as right, and recall at 20 is the share of the right passages that appear in my top 20. Both use only documents published before each query's date. Normalized discounted cumulative gain at 10 (nDCG at 10) is in the table beside them.
- **Rolling coverage of the 8-in-10 range.** Of the packages that finished in the last 12 months, the share that finished inside the 8-in-10 range I gave them. A well-sized range catches about 8 in 10, so the target is 75 to 85 percent. Coverage outside it for 2 months in a row raises a retrain.
- **Plan accuracy.** The median number of days between a plan row's planned signing date and the actual one, early or late. I report it for plan rows dated within 14 days of a date I offered and for all other plan rows, and separately for countries not yet using Strata.
